acceptance_scope: Synthetic and CONDITIONAL_ON_P4 only. This run cannot promote P4/P5-P8, establish experimental validation, or accept the Commercial Core.
fixture_selection: Fixture C is the previously distinct piston-port, no-reed candidate. It retains the committed Fixture A geometry/topology and removes only the intake reed; this directly tests the earlier candidate that failed before its first complete cycle.
horizon_policy: Run and persist all 20 complete 360-degree cycles if admissible; no early stopping on a detector classification. If any cycle fails, persist failure.json with the reached angle, full rejection history, partial state and ledger. This is a fixed prospective horizon.
outputs: restart-audit.json when the registered replay is reached
failure.json if integration or restart fails
rejected_step_policy: Record every rejected trial with angle, attempted step and reason before halving; preserve all accepted-stage cycle evidence and write failure.json on an unsuccessful cycle.
restart_policy: At the terminal cycle-3 snapshot, reconstruct from the committed Fixture C config, restore the snapshot, advance one full cycle, and require exact full-snapshot equality with the continuous run.
selection_rationale: Selection is based on the unresolved B1/A4 finding and prior 107.651626-degree failure, not on new outcomes. The original raw failing trace is unavailable; this campaign records every retry and persists a failure receipt if a full cycle cannot complete.
threshold_policy: Use the existing detector thresholds and three consecutive valid comparisons unchanged; report PASS, FAIL and INVALID distinctly.
